[SWS_UCM_00184] Persistent data clean-up after Software Cluster re- moval
⌈
UCM shall remove persistent data of a removed SoftwareCluster by ag-
gregating the information given in the application manifest, namely PersistencyKeyVal-
ueStorage.uri and PersistencyFileStorage.uri, in order to leave the AUTOSAR Adap-
tive Platform and the file system clean.
⌋
